title: Settings
description: How {{workspace}} works in HCO CRM: business details, team, channels and who gets new leads.

readOnly.owner: Only the owner can change workspace settings. You can see them here.
readOnly.ownerShort: Only the owner can invite teammates
readOnly.team: Only the owner can invite teammates, change roles or deactivate people.
readOnly.channels: Only the owner can connect or disconnect channels. You can still connect your own Gmail.
readOnly.assignment: Only the owner or a manager can change how leads are assigned.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Your business details appear on quotes and in messages to customers.

business.title: Business details
business.description: Printed on every quote you send.

errors.name: Enter the business name.
errors.trn: A TRN has 15 digits. Check the number on your VAT certificate.

tax.title: Tax, currency and time
tax.description: Set for the UAE so totals and times are always right.
tax.currencyNote: UAE dirham, used for every deal and quote
tax.timezoneNote: Due dates, reminders and reports use Dubai time

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.description: Catch deals before they slip away.
followUp.label: Flag a deal as going cold after
followUp.help: Open deals with no messages, notes or stage moves for this long get a flag on the pipeline and appear in the assignee's Today list.

team.title: Team
team.description: Everyone who signs in to this workspace, and what they can do.
team.selfRole: Ask another owner to change your role

empty.title: Invite your team
empty.description: Add the people who reply to leads and move deals. Each gets their own sign-in.

roleHelp.rep: Works the leads, conversations and deals assigned to them.
roleHelp.manager: Sees every record and the dashboard. Can set lead assignment.
roleHelp.owner: Everything, including settings, channels and the team.

inviteDialog.title: Invite a teammate
inviteDialog.description: They get a link to sign in to this workspace.
inviteDialog.name: Full name

inviteResult.title: {{name}} can join now
inviteResult.description: Send them this link on WhatsApp or email. It signs them in to this workspace.
inviteResult.copyManually: Select the link and copy it
inviteResult.demoNote: In the demo, the link signs them in straight away. Open it in a new window to see the CRM as them.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where leads and messages come from. Everything a connected channel receives lands in Leads and the Inbox.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.description: Reply to customers from the Inbox on your business number. Messages to this number arrive live, with delivery and read ticks.
whatsapp.consequence: New WhatsApp messages stop arriving in the Inbox and replies can't be sent. Past conversations stay on each timeline.

meta.name: Facebook & Instagram lead ads
meta.description: Leads from your instant forms arrive in Leads within seconds, tagged Facebook or Instagram, with every form answer.
meta.consequence: New leads from your Facebook and Instagram forms stop arriving. Existing leads stay where they are.

tiktok.name: TikTok lead forms
tiktok.description: Leads from TikTok instant forms arrive in Leads, assigned like every other lead.
tiktok.pendingNext: Leads start arriving automatically once TikTok approves.
tiktok.consequence: The access request is cancelled. You can connect TikTok again at any time.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.description: Each teammate connects their own mailbox, so quotes and replies go out from their address and answers land in the Inbox.
gmail.notConnectedHint: Connect it to send quotes and emails from your own address.
gmail.consequence: Emails stop syncing to the Inbox and you can't send quotes by email from your address.

simulator.name: Demo simulator
simulator.description: Creates realistic leads and WhatsApp messages through the same path real channels use, so every screen behaves as it will live.
simulator.note: Replies to simulated conversations never leave the CRM.

connect.busyDetail: Demo connection: this takes a moment, just like the real thing.
connect.demoNote: Demo connection. No sign-in window opens and nothing is shared.

whatsapp.title: Connect WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.intro: Sign in with the Facebook account that manages your WhatsApp Business account. HCO CRM will be able to:
whatsapp.codeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code sent by SMS to {{phone}}
whatsapp.codeDemo: Demo connection: the code is filled in for you.
whatsapp.codeError: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.
whatsapp.doneBody: Messages to {{phone}} now arrive in the Inbox, and replies go out from this number.

meta.title: Connect Facebook & Instagram lead ads
meta.intro: Sign in with the Facebook account that runs your ads. HCO CRM will be able to:
meta.permPages: See the Facebook pages you manage
meta.permLeads: Receive leads from your instant forms
meta.permInstagram: Tell Instagram leads apart from Facebook leads
meta.choosePage: Which page runs your lead ads?
meta.chooseForms: Leads from these forms on {{page}} will arrive in Leads.
meta.doneBody_one: New leads from {{count}} form on {{page}} arrive in Leads within seconds.
meta.doneBody_other: New leads from {{count}} forms on {{page}} arrive in Leads within seconds.

tiktok.title: Connect TikTok lead forms
tiktok.intro: Sign in with your TikTok for Business account. HCO CRM will ask TikTok for permission to:
tiktok.permForms: See the instant forms on your ad account
tiktok.permLeads: Receive leads as soon as they are submitted
tiktok.chooseAccount: Which ad account collects your leads?
tiktok.reviewBody: TikTok reviews every app that reads lead data. Once approved, leads from this account arrive in Leads automatically.
tiktok.doneBody: We switch this channel on as soon as TikTok approves. There's nothing else to do.

gmail.title: Connect my Gmail
gmail.intro: Connect your own mailbox so emails you send from the CRM come from your address.
gmail.permSend: Read, write and send email from {{email}}
gmail.permThreads: Show email threads with your contacts in the Inbox
gmail.doneBody: Emails you send from the CRM go out from {{email}}, and replies land in the Inbox.

assignment.title: Lead assignment
assignment.description: Decide who picks up each new lead, so every enquiry gets an owner within seconds.
assignment.returningNote: Returning customers who are already contacts stay with their current assignee, whatever the rule.

errors.noneEligible: Choose at least one teammate for round-robin, or switch to manual.

next.label: Next lead goes to
next.onlyOne: Every new lead goes to them.
next.manualHelp: Someone picks each lead up, or a manager assigns it from Leads.
next.nobodyHelp: Tick at least one teammate below.

round_robin.label: Round-robin
round_robin.help: Leads take turns through the chosen teammates, one each, so work is shared evenly.

manual.label: Manual
manual.help: Leads arrive unassigned. A teammate or manager assigns each one.

eligible.title: Who takes new leads
eligible.description: Leads rotate through these people in this order.

onboarding.title: Set up your workspace
onboarding.subtitle: Five short steps. You can change all of this later in Settings.

business.title: Your business
business.description: This name and TRN appear on your quotes.
business.name: Business name
business.namePlaceholder: As it appears on your trade licence
business.trnHelp: Your 15-digit UAE Tax Registration Number. Add it now or later.

owner.title: About you
owner.description: You sign in with this email.
owner.name: Your name
owner.emailHelp: Use the email you check every day. Lead alerts go here.
owner.roleNote: You'll be the owner: you see every lead, deal and conversation, and you control settings, channels and the team.

team.title: Invite your team
team.description: Add the people who reply to leads. Reps take turns getting new leads.
team.name: Full name
team.empty: Just you for now. Invite people whenever you're ready.
team.later: You can invite more people later from Settings.

pipeline.title: Your pipeline
pipeline.description: The stages a deal moves through, from first enquiry to closed.

review.title: Review and create
review.description: Check the details. Everything can be changed later.

preview.label: Workspace preview
preview.hint: Your workspace updates as you type.

errors.trn: A TRN has 15 digits. Check the number on your VAT certificate.
errors.email: Enter a valid email, like name@business.ae.
errors.emailTwice: This email is already used above. Each person needs their own.
errors.stageName: Name this stage, or remove it.
errors.stageTwice: Each stage needs a different name.
